Required libraries: Praw to interact with reddit's API.

Required dependencies: To avoid secure connection errors install ndg-httpsclient and pyasn1. You can install them with pip as follows:

pip install ndg-httpsclient pyasn1

Bugs: I'm not an expert at writing reddit bots so there's a couple of bugs to be aware of.

  • If you enter the wrong username or password the program will crash (I was just lazy here).

  • If you login with a user that has no comments the program will hang.

  • Once all the comments are deleted the program will hang.

The last 2 are kind of weird. When trying to validate user objects I couldn't figure out how to get a False if there's no comments (which really screwed me up, but the program works).
